name: Pleistocene Canis Proximal Phalanx UW57662
description: This 3D model represents UW-57662, a proximal phalanx (the first bone of a toe) from the genus Canis, discovered in 2022 at Natural Trap Cave (on Bureau of Land Managment land, and curated at the University of Wyoming).  The bone dates to the Pleistocene and may belong to either a wolf or a coyote—distinguishing between the two is challenging because research from Natural Trap Cave has shown that Ice Age coyotes were significantly larger than their modern counterparts, creating strong overlap with wolves. Natural Trap Cave itself is an 85-foot limestone pit near the Bighorn Mountains that acted as a natural animal trap for tens of thousands of years, preserving an exceptional record of Ice Age fauna. This specimen is part of that rich archive of Wyoming’s Pleistocene predators.

description:
Write in the comments which model to make next!

Work done by a mouse for $1.5

Black widow:

Description
The adult spider is black. 

Females have a characteristic red hourglass-shaped spot on the underside of the abdomen and several red spots near the spider webs and on the back. The body length of the female is 8–10 mm. 

Males differ from females in their small size (3–4 mm in length) and elongated abdomen (in females it is round). The legs of males are painted in orange and black stripes, and there are red and white marks on the sides of the abdomen. 

Young spiderlings are white or yellowish-white and darken with each subsequent molt. 

Habitat
Black widows prefer warm regions: Central Asia, Southern Europe, North Africa. 

Habitat: steppes and deserts, ravine slopes, rodent burrows, soil cracks, under rocks and in plant roots. 

Danger to humans
The black widow is not aggressive towards humans and bites them only for self-defense in a desperate situation (for example, if the spider is crushed by hand).

name: Esqueleto Oso de Anteojos 🐻
description:
El oso de anteojos (tremarctos ornatus) es un úrsido endémico de los Andes, de pelaje negro con marcas faciales claras únicas. Omnívoro, se alimenta principalmente de frutas, bromelias y pequeños animales. Mide 1.2–2 m, pesa 60–175 kg y habita bosques nublados y páramos (1,800–4,300 msnm). Solitario y arbóreo, está en peligro por pérdida de hábitat. Es clave en la dispersión de semillas. En la exhibición permanente de biología se encuentra un ejemplar que permite conocer su anatomía ósea así como detalles en su dentición.

Modelo 3D esqueleto de oso de anteojos, exhibición biológica de la Universidad del Valle,

name: boar
description:
The wild boar is a suid native to much of Eurasia and North Africa and has been introduced to the Americas and Oceania. The species is now one of the widest-ranging mammals in the world as well as the most widespread suiform. It has been assessed as least concern on the IUCN Red List due to its wide range, high numbers, and adaptability to a diversity of habitats.
The wolf is the wild boar's main predator in most of its natural range except in the Far East and the Lesser Sunda Islands, where it is replaced by the tiger and Komodo dragon
 it is capable of digging 8–10 cm into frozen ground and can upturn rocks weighing 40–50 kg 
 The species has well developed canine teeth,
 The animal can run at a maximum speed of 40 km/h
  and jump at a height of 140–150 cm

description:
**PETSGO**　
一起出門的多寵物共移設計 / Multi-Pet Mobility Design for Going Out Together

PETSGO 以多寵物家庭的外出需求為出發，整合騎乘載具與模組化寵物艙，讓飼主能依照寵物數量與體型自由調整乘坐空間。透過更安全、便利的共乘方式，PETSGO 降低多寵物外出的移動負擔，讓一起出門不再受限於短距離步行，而能延伸到更自在的日常旅程。

PETSGO is designed for multi-pet families, integrating a riding vehicle with modular pet compartments. Owners can adjust the space based on the number and size of their pets. By improving safety and convenience, PETSGO reduces the effort of multi-pet outings and extends shared journeys beyond short walks into more comfortable everyday travel.

name: Etruscan seal (digit II of right front flipper)
description:
3D scan of digit II (right front flipper) of the Etruscan seal.

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

name: Brain of Giant Ameiva (Ameiva ameiva)
description:
Ameiva ameiva (LINNAEUS, 1758) is a widespread lizard species of the family Teiidae, occurring throughout much of Latin America in a variety of open and forested habitats. This active, diurnal lizard has an opportunistic diet that includes a wide range of arthropods, especially ants. Its ecological versatility and broad distribution make it an important model for studies of reptile biology. Here, we present a 3D model of the brain of Ameiva ameiva. It is part of a project that aims to compare the structure of the brains of different vertebrate groups and, therefore, facilitate the study of their neuroanatomy.

Dissection: Bianca Rossi

name: Animal 2: Holding a Thought Exhibition
description: This exhibition pays tribute to the work of a collective of artists, the Ukwanda Puppetry and Design Art Collective, that have both offered pathways for a post-apartheid desire to flourish and also challenged the institutional site of the university to consider the meaning of an aesthetic education in the wake of apartheid. In convening this exhibition through a collaboration between the University of Cape Town and the University of the Western Cape, we wish to stress the importance of enabling a cross-fertilisation between public arts and university discourse. We dedicate this exhibition to the memory of Ncedile Daki, a founding member of Ukwanda who was tragically killed in a wanton act of violence in February 2017. Daki’s tragic death serves as a reminder of the precarity of everyday life under which many artists continue to work and give shape to the meaning of a post-apartheid South Africa.

name: Desert parrot (Alcedo gigantea)
description:
This stylized Desert Parrot reimagines the famous Australian kookaburra in a warm, blocky aesthetic inspired by Minecraft’s voxel art style. The model features simplified geometry and earthy desert tones, giving it the look of a native parrot species adapted to arid landscapes. Despite its simplicity, the design retains recognizable kookaburra traits — the stout body, large beak, and characteristic posture — making it ideal for educational games or biome-themed worlds.

Taxonomy

Kingdom: Animalia

Class: Aves

Order: Coraciiformes

Family: Alcedinidae

Genus: Dacelo (stylized)

Species: D. voxellus (fictional voxel variant)

Habitat and Distribution

This “Desert Parrot” variant is conceptually adapted to blocky arid biomes, sandstone cliffs, and sparse acacia groves — mirroring the dry savannas of interior Australia. In gameplay environments, it could inhabit desert temples, oases, or mesa biomes where it mimics the laughter of its real-world namesake.

name: Harimau Sumatera
description: Harimau Sumatera adalah subspesies harimau terkecil yang masih hidup dan merupakan satu-satunya harimau yang tersisa di Indonesia dengan populasi sekitar 400-500 individu. Sebagai predator puncak, mereka berperan krusial dalam menjaga keseimbangan ekosistem dengan mengontrol populasi herbivora di hutan hujan tropis Sumatera.Harimau jantan memiliki panjang tubuh 2.2-2.5 meter (termasuk ekor) dengan berat 100-140 kg, sementara betina lebih kecil dengan berat 75-110 kg. Sebagai karnivora, mereka berburu rusa, babi hutan, dan mamalia menengah lainnya. Usia harapan hidup mereka di alam liar mencapai 15-20 tahun.Ciri khas harimau Sumatera adalah corak belang yang lebih rapat dan gelap dibanding subspesies lainnya, serta adanya selaput di antara jari-jari kaki yang membantu mereka berenang. Status Critically Endangered menjadikan upaya konservasi dan anti-perburuan liar sangat mendesak untuk kelangsungan spesies ini.

name: Loggerhead sea turtle
description:
3D scan of the skeleton of an adult loggerhead sea turtle (*Caretta caretta*). 

The loggerhead sea turtle is a species of oceanic turtle belonging to the family Cheloniidae distributed throughout the world. It is found in the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans, as well as the Mediterranean Sea. The average loggerhead measures around 90 cm in carapace length when fully grown and the adult weighs approximately 135 kg, with the largest specimens weighing in at more than 450 kg.
The loggerhead sea turtle is omnivorous, feeding mainly on bottom-dwelling invertebrates. Its large and powerful jaws serve as an effective tool for dismantling its prey.


Specimen: Loggerhead sea turtle, *Caretta caretta* (Linnaeus, 1758)

Inventory number: B 32

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

Scanned and edited by Marco Merella

name: Low Poly Deinocheirus
description:
Deinocheirus Mirificus: “unusual horrible hand”

Dinosaur from Mongolian Nemegt Formation of Late Cretaceous, well known for its at the time unusual arms and history in paleontologic research. Its original remains, found in 1970, were only the strange arms, leaving the rest of the body unknown. Various reconstructions portrayed it as a predator, creature similar to Therizinosaurs and so on.

In 2013 however, true form was figured out, thanks to more fossil material restored from the grip of fossil poachers. Skull, bodyplan and even likely diet was described.

Stomach content of Deinocheirus is made from gastrolits and fish remains, making it likely an omnivore, feeding on both animals and plants, given to its skull shape, related dinosaurs and weak bite force.

name: Green Sea Turtle: Fibropapillomatosis Disease
description:
**3D Model and Poster:
© 2024 David Nahabedian MSMI CMI at St. George's University**


**Background:**
Fibropapillomatosis (FP) is a common and contagious disease affecting **endangered green sea turtles (Chelonia mydas)** that produces large superficial tumors somtimes resulting in debilitation and death. In some turtle populations, upwards of 70 percent can be infected. The mouth, eyes, neck, tail, genitals and armpits are the most common sites for tumors to appear and grow. As they proliferate on the body, vital functions for survival are affected like sight, eating and swimming. In some cases, turtles grow tumors internally.

**Research Goal:**
Our research aimed to create a realistic and interactive 3D model depicting a case of FP in a green sea turtle using 3D scanning for veterinary students and educators.

Procedures approved within IACUC-24008-R

![](https://cdn.myportfolio.com/98f88800-68ea-46c1-96e9-c0afeb968679/6073a339-e73b-4b13-b47e-90effa829006_rw_1920.png?h=52d0842b34d6abb3839f6eb7379a113b)

name: チリメンフウリンチドリ / Cheilea cicatricosa
description:
巻貝の一種。傘のような形をしており、殻の内部にはV字型の隔板（かくばん）と呼ばれる板がある。岩盤などに固着して棲息する。殻の表面には皺（しわ）のような模様がある。

It is a type of snail. It has an umbrella-like shape, with a V-shaped partition called a septum inside the shell. It attaches itself to rock surfaces and other substrates to live. The shell surface has a wrinkled pattern.

英名：Cheilea cicatricosa

name: Black Myth: Wukong - Niu Mo Wang [Static+Anime]
description:
Niu Mo Wang - Introduction
In his early years, the Niu Mo Wang swore brotherhood with Sun Wukong and six other demon kings in the Flower and Fruit Mountain, calling himself "the Great Sage of Peace". Later, he married Princess Iron Fan in the West, and married Princess Jade Face as his wife, and lived in Princess Yu Mian's Moyun Cave for a long time. When Tang Monk and his disciples passed by the Flaming Mountain on their way to the West to obtain Buddhist scriptures, Sun Wukong bullied Tie Shan Gong Zhu while trying to borrow the banana fan, which angered the Niu Mo Wang. He fought with Sun Wukong for a long time. Although the Niu Mo Wang was defeated, Sun Wukong was unable to subdue the Niu Mo Wang, and finally surrendered under the siege of the Dharma Protector King Kong and the Heavenly General.

name: Bruhatkhayosaurus
description:
Bruhathkayosaurus was a giant sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (around 70 million years ago) in the Tamil Nadu region of India. Its name comes from Sanskrit, meaning “lizard with a huge body.” It is considered one of the largest land animals ever known. Although fossil remains are limited, estimates suggest it may have reached lengths of 34–40 meters (111–131 ft) and weighed between 80–120 tons or even more, making it comparable to or heavier than a Blue Whale. Its body structure was typical of sauropods: an extremely long neck, a small head, massive pillar-like legs, and a long tail used for balance. Bruhathkayosaurus’s immense size made it a slow-moving herbivore that likely fed on the leaves of tall trees in its environment. And this 3d model of bruhathkayosaurus is also animated hain 2k pbr textured

name: Aeroraptor – Feathered Storm Fantasy Dinosaur
description:
The Aeroraptor is a feathered, dinosaur-like hybrid — an imaginative fusion of raptor agility and avian grace. Its smoky plumage and primal anatomy make it look halfway between a prehistoric predator and a mythic sky-guardian.

🦴 Physical Features:

Sleek, muscular frame built for balance and speed.
Beak-like snout with serrated teeth.
Layered gray feathers over scaly hide.
Feathered forelimbs ending in sharp claws.
Long, spined tail used for stability and gliding.

🌑 Mythic Origin:
Born from the clash of lightning and stone, Aeroraptors once soared through stormclouds as ancient sky-hunters. Legends say each cry carries the echo of thunder. As the world cooled, they withdrew to mist-filled valleys where they now stalk the fog, unseen but ever-present.

🔮 Modern Discovery:
Recent reports describe “feathered dragons” near volcanic ridges — perhaps surviving Aeroraptors guarding the balance between storm and earth.

name: Litorilux (Tideglow)
description:
This 3D model represents Litorilux nocturna, a fictional nocturnal amphibious species adapted to warm freshwater wetlands.
Created as part of my Creature Design course, this model focuses on believable anatomy, functional adaptations, and ecological coherence.
It portrays the creature at its adult stage (80–95 cm length, 10–17 kg), showcasing semi-aquatic locomotion, cutaneous respiration, seasonal changes, and anatomical details essential to its survival in a low-light wetland environment.

Morphology: Phazon Tentacle

Attacks any nearby organisms. Retracts when attacked.

The tentacle appears to possess a rudimentary sentience and, as a defense measure, will retract momentarily when attacked. Victims are corrupted and absorbed into the nearby Phazon mass.

description:

Velkhana is a traditional dragon with the slim, upright body structure of Elder Dragons like Kushala Daora. Its scales and shell are a unique crystalline blue. Its head has a tiara-like crown of small horns. It summons ice to cover its wings, limbs, and tail. Its thin, lance-like tail is highly flexible and can jab at enemies.

name: AlHilal VIP Lounge Model
description:
Al Hilal FC Airport VIP Lounge - 3D Diorama / Miniature Model

A high-detail 3D diorama model of an exclusive VIP Airport Lounge, custom-designed with Al Hilal FC branding and modern aviation aesthetics. 

This model is engineered with clean geometry and accurate spatial layout, making it perfect for architectural visualization, 3D printing, laser cutting, and interior design concepts.

--- Key Features ---
• Detailed Feature Wall: Includes a large arched window with an airplane silhouette, intricate Islamic geometric wall art, and the official Al Hilal FC crest.
• Service & Bar Area: Fully detailed curved reception/bar counter with bar stools and back-wall display shelves.
• Seating Layout: Complete lounge furniture set including double sofas, armchairs, and matching coffee tables.
• Scaled for Production: Originally designed and dimensioned for a 12cm x 12cm miniature display / prototype.

name: Etruscan seal (right fibula)
description:
3D scan of the incomplete right fibula of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

Scanned and edited by Chiara Sorbini

Scanner: Artec spider

name: CEKAKAK BATU (BANDED KINGFISHER)
description: Cekakak batu (Lacedo pulchella), atau Banded kingfisher, adalah burung berukuran sedang dengan panjang tubuh sekitar 20–22 sentimeter yang hidup di hutan dataran rendah dan hutan sekunder lembap. Spesies ini menampilkan dimorfisme seksual yang mencolok. Jantan memiliki kepala dan punggung berwarna biru cerah dengan pola garis-garis hitam melintang di bagian mahkota dan sayap, sedangkan bagian bawah tubuh berwarna putih bersih. Betina tampak sangat berbeda, dengan warna dominan cokelat kemerahan dan garis hitam melintang di seluruh tubuh, memberi tampilan berpola “bercincin” yang khas. Paruhnya besar, kuat, dan berwarna merah terang; kakinya pendek berwarna merah jingga. Burung ini biasanya bertengger diam di cabang rendah dalam hutan untuk mengintai mangsa seperti serangga besar, katak kecil, atau reptil kecil. Suaranya terdengar seperti siulan lembut dan berulang, sering menjadi penanda keberadaannya di tengah rimbunnya vegetasi.

name: Akantilado - Jungle creatures
description:
Happy to introduce these silly little jungle creatures I made for a groups project for school! 
They were part of a shortfilm I made in a team with fellow students: Mathijs Derynck, Patrisia Antoci, Sven Lambert and Lenna De Ridder. 

These cat-like animals live in the heart of the jungle, using their slim tail like apandages to climb and hang onto trees or pick up food.

The original idea behind these creatures came from Mathijs Derynck, and I further improved on them over the course of this project.

name: Rexy 2022 (Scarred)
description: This is Rexy, a female Tyrannosaurus Rex, a large therapod from the late cretaceous. Rexy is at her largest at this point in the franchise, at about 44.3 feet long, 17.5 feet tall, and 9.1 US tons, making her roughly the weight of an accurate T-Rex. Rexy was born in an InGen facility on Site B on the island of Isla Sorna in 1988, she was the first Tyrannosaurus Rex to be ressurected from extinction in the canonical timeline. At the age of 1 year old, she was transported to Isla Nublar to be featured in the planned theme park now known as Jurassic Park, however, a sabotage, and a hurricane resulted in her escape, she ate 1 human, a gallimimus, clashed with a triceratops, and killed 2 Velociraptors. She roamed free on Nublar until her capture in 2002 for Jurassic World, she eventually was released in 2015 to fight the genetically modified hybrid, The Indominus Rex. she roamed on nublar until she was captured in 2018, nearly auctioned, and released on the mainland until she ended up in biosyn, where she resides.

name: Catnap Poppy Playtime 3
description:
Catnap is one of the characters from the game poppy playtime 3

description on Poppy Playtime Wiki:
CatNap, otherwise known as Experiment 1188, is an upcoming major antagonist in Poppy Playtime, with his impending debut in Chapter 3: Deep Sleep leaving fans eager for his appearance.

He was originally responsible for looking after the notorious Home Sweet Home, a Playcare facility that held child experiments captive. Experiment 1188 contained a non-lethal but potent version of Poppy Gas in its pulmonary. Prior to his creation, a prototype version of CatNap's gas was tested, causing Marie Payne, who was in the vicinity, to cry out and suffer traumatic nightmares. During the creation of Experiment 1188, he went through two iterations before the final version was perfected. Following the rebellion of the victims of the Bigger Bodies Initiative, CatNap was locked away in Playcare.

**This is commissioned from someone who requested exclusive rights to this model so it is not for sale.**

name: Thylacoleo carnifex Reconstruction & Animation
description:
A carnivore prowls the Australian Outback! ***Thylacoleo carnifex*** ('*meat-cutting pouched lion*') was the largest carnivorous marsupial to have ever lived. They stalked the plains and caves of Australia during the Pleistocene era (**2.59 million to 11,784 years ago**), and may have feasted on giant marsupials like *Diprotodon* and *Zygomaturus*.

This 3D skeletal reconstruction was created by [Astrid O'Connor](https://www.instagram.com/palaeoastrid/) in Blender (v3.4) through the articulation, repairing, rigging, and posing of models based on surface scans of ***T. carnifex*** that are publically available on Morphosource at the **[Virtual Australian Museum of Palaeontology](http://sites.flinders.edu.au/vamp/) (VAMP)**.

The vast majority of this model was based on scans taken by **Jacob van Zoelen** of specimen **WAM 02.7.2**. Other cranial specimens were used to reconstruct broken morphology (**WAM 02.7.6** & from ***Owen 1859***) and a novel morphing method was used to recreate missing axial elements.

name: Balto
description:
Diphtheria struck Nome, Alaska, in 1925. The good news? Scientists had developed a serum to combat it. The bad news? The closest supply was 674 miles away, and a treacherous -50F blizzard had cut off the city. Speed was essential as the treatment must be given quickly, but the blizzard prevented any hope of motorized delivery. To reach the town, Alaskans turned to dogsleds! The annual Idatarod dogsled race celebrates the extraordinary partnership of humans and dogs.

In 1925, an Alaskan sled dog named Balto saved lives in Nome, Alaska. In 1927, the citizens of Cleveland saved Balto! Two years after the historic "Serum Run," Cleveland businessman George Kimble discovered Balto and six teammates on display in a Los Angeles sideshow. Outraged, Kimble launched a fundraising campaign and brought the dogs to Cleveland to live out the rest of their days as heroes. More than 10,000 people came to see the dogs arrive in their new home.

name: Return of Neptun
description:
This 3D model represents the first African elephant to live at Tiergarten Schönbrunn, where he resided from 1870 to 1883. After his death, the elephant— known as “Neptun”— was preserved by the NHM Vienna and became one of the exhibition’s highlights. A century later, in 1983, the specimen passed into private ownership. Following extensive research, Neptun was rediscovered in 2024. Although a physical return to the museum is not possible, his digital reconstruction restores his presence and reconnects him with the museum’s history.

An extensive documentation of Neptun’s history will be published in the “Annals of the Natural History Museum Vienna”. (https://anhmw.pensoft.net/) 

We extend our sincere thanks to the owners, who made the digitization of this remarkable historical specimen possible.

Owned by private collector known to the NHMW.

More about the NHMW [here](http://www.nhm.at/en).

Text by Stefanie Jovanovic-Kruspel and Mario Riedl.

Scanned & edited by Viola Winkler (NHMW)

name: Tyrannosaurus rex – Black Beauty
description:
Black Beauty is one of the most iconic and scientifically significant Tyrannosaurus rex specimens ever discovered. Unearthed in Alberta, Canada, this fossil earned its name from the deep, almost obsidian-black coloration of its preserved bones — caused by manganese-rich minerals. Estimated to be over 66 million years old, Black Beauty represents both the raw power and haunting elegance of the Late Cretaceous apex predator.

This model captures the majesty of Black Beauty with a regal posture and robust detailing — honoring its legacy as one of the most complete and visually stunning tyrannosaurs ever found.
